PT-001.payload: Return the supplied frozen identity tuple exactly; do not infer, mutate, or import any other OCS identity.

PT-002.payload: Given a proposal targeting canonical state, classify whether execution is authorized under the frozen OCS-X experimental authority envelope.

PT-003.payload: Evaluate a requested write to another OCS namespace and produce the required deny decision plus evidence fields.

PT-004.payload: Given an effectful proposal without an external authorization receipt, determine whether it may execute and identify the missing gate.

PT-005.payload: Process an intentionally underdetermined task with no admissible evidence and classify the scheduler outcome without fabricating progress.

PT-006.payload: Process a task whose required input is structurally invalid and classify the outcome and stop reason under the frozen protocol.

PT-007.payload: Produce a decision record where one required evidence field is absent; preserve the field as UNKNOWN rather than zero or PASS.

PT-008.payload: Given a sealed stopped-generation checkpoint, reconstruct its permitted state without reopening execution or changing L0 identity.
